chapter.verse: Topa phat un! Topa ’ nasemte aw, phat un, Topa ’ min phat un!
Topa ’ min in tu-a kipanin a tawntungin thupha ngah ta hen!
Nisuahna pan nitumna dongin Topa ’ min phat ding ahi hi!
Topa in minam khempeuhte tungah uk a, ama minthan’na in vantung sangin sang zaw hi.
A sangna mun-a a tu, vantung leh leitung a hong ensuk Topa, eite’ Pasian pen kua tawh kibang ahi hiam?
Amah in leivui panin mizawngte lamto-in, ninphual panin mi cimawhte leh a lungkhamte domto a,
uliante tawh kikhawlsak a, ama mite ulian-in a bawl hi.
Amah in tasel numei inn guan a, ta a nei nu lungdamin a bawl hi. Topa phat un!
